content.rendered:
Special menu Valentine’s Day ❤️🌹💌
Este 14 de febrero, enamórate despacio.
Copa a copa. Plato a plato. Mirada a mirada.
Nuestro menú de San Valentín está pensado para eso: que el tiempo se detenga en la mesa.💘

🥂💌 This February 14th, fall in love slowly.
Glass by glass. Dish by dish. Glance by glance.
Our Valentine’s Day menu is designed for just that: to make time stand still at the table.
